canonical_activity_model.confirmed_status_semantics: ActivityStatus contains Not Started, In Progress, and Completed.
canonical_activity_model.confirmed_type_semantics: ActivityType contains Task Dependent, Resource Dependent, Level of Effort, Start Milestone, Finish Milestone, and WBS Summary.
canonical_activity_model.finding: The canonical scheduling Activity model already has the semantic enums needed for P6 Status and Type, but it is not itself an interchange serializer or persistence adapter.

authoritative_activity_persistence.finding: ActivityMaster is an authoritative Activity persistence boundary, but the current persisted contract does not contain the Tranche 4 fields. Extending it would therefore be a domain/persistence contract change, not a harmless alias or registry-only mapping.

interchange_boundary.finding: The repository has a provider-neutral P6 interchange mapping boundary. P6InterchangeMapper only applies persisted P6MappingDefinition records; codecs parse/serialize provider grammar and do not define canonical P6 semantics. No persisted mapping for the Tranche 4 Status/Type fields was verified in this review.

certification_effect.reason: The repository ingress/egress boundary is now identified, but field-level Oracle write/import semantics and a persisted canonical mapping record are still not jointly evidenced. Adding fields to ActivityMaster or creating a parallel serializer before that evidence would bypass the existing mapping boundary.

required_evidence: P6MappingDefinition for the exact interchange format
round-trip or lossless behavior evidence appropriate to the format
next_implementation_gate.guardrail: Do not create duplicate registry identities or a second Activity serialization path.
